senses.gloss: ब्रध्न m. 1. The sun; 2. the root of a tree; 3. a day; 4. the Arka plant; 5. an epithet of Śiva; 6. of Brahman (m.); 7. lead.
ब्रह्म n. The supreme spirit.

ब्राह्म (I) a. (f. ह्मी) 1. Relating to Brahman (m.), R.xiii.60; 2. relating to Brahman (n.), Bg.ii.72; 3. relating to the Brāhmaṇas; 4. holy, sacred; 5. relating to sacred knowledge; 6. relating to or prescribed by the Vedas.

ब्राह्म (II) m. 1. One of the eight forms of marriage; in it, the bride is bestowed on the bridegroom decorated and without any gift from the bridegroom, (ब्राह्मो विवाह आहूय दीयते शक्त्यलंकृता Yaj.i.58), M.iii.27; 2. an epithet of Nārada.
ब्राह्म (III) n. 1. The part of the hand under the root of the thumb; 2. study of the Veda; 3. a missile presided oyer by Brahman (m.), R.xii.97.
ब्रह्मण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Relating to Brahman (n.); 2. relating to Brahman (m.); 3. fit for a Brāhmaṇa; 4. favourable to a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मण्य (II) m. 1. The mulberry tree; 2. munjā grass; 3. the palm tree; 4. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 5. of Kārtikeya; 6. of Saturn.
ब्रह्मण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Relating to Brahman (n.); 2. relating to Brahman (m.); 3. fit for a Brāhmaṇa; 4. favourable to a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मण्या f. An epithet of Durgā.
ब्राह्मण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) Suitable for a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण्य (II) m. An epithet of the planet Saturn.
ब्राह्मण्य (III) n. 1. A multitude of Brāhmaṇas; 2. the rank of a Brāhmaṇa, M.iii.17.
ब्राह्मण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) Suitable for a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मण्य-देव m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

ब्रह्मन् (I) m. 1. The first deity of the Hindu triad on whom falls the duty of creating the world, तस्मिञ् जज्ञे स्वयं ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः M.i.9; 2. a Brnhmana; 3. one of the four principal priests at a Soma sacrifice; 4. an epithet of Bṛhaspati; 5. an epithet of Śiva; 6. the sun; 7. intellect; 8. an epithet of the seven sages (मरीच, अत्रि, अंगिरस्, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, क्रतु and वसिष्ठ).

ब्रह्मन् (II) n. 1. The supreme being regarded as impersonal, the soul of the universe from which all created things emanate and to which they return; 2. the mystic syllable Om, एकाक्षरं परं ब्रह्म M.ii.83; 3. the Vedas (collectively); See M.i.23, ii.172; 4. a Mantra used as a spell; 5. penance, austerity; 6. chastity, celibacy; 7. final beatitude or emancipation; 8. the Brāhmaṇīcal caste (collectively), ब्रह्मैव संनियंतृ स्यात्क्षतं हि ब्रह्मसंभवम् M.ix.320; 9. wealth.
ब्रह्मन्-अक्षर n. the sacred syllable Om.
ब्रह्मन्-अग्रभू m. a horse.
ब्रह्मन्-अंजलि m. 1. obeisance to a preceptor at the beginning and end of a Vedic recital; 2. joining the hollowed hands while repeating the Vedas.
ब्रह्मन्-अंड n. the mundane egg, the universe, the world.
ब्रह्मन्-अंड˚पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-अभिजाता f. an epithet of the river Godāvarī.
ब्रह्मन्-अधिगम m. repetition of the Vedas.
ब्रह्मन्-अधिगमन n. repetition of the Vedas.
ब्रह्मन्-अभ्यास m. the study of the Veda.
ब्रह्मन्-अंभस् n. the urine of a cow.
ब्रह्मन्-अयण, -अयन m. an epithet of Nārāyaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-अयण, -अयन m. an epithet of Nārāyaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-अर्पण n. 1. the offering of sacred knowledge; 2. dedication to the supreme being.
ब्रह्मन्-अस्त्र n. a missile presided over by Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-आत्मभू m. a horse.
ब्रह्मन्-आनंद m. the rapture of absorption into Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मन्-आरंभ m. commencement of the recital of the Vedas, M.ii.71.
ब्रह्मन्-आवर्त m. name of the country lying between the rivers Sarasvatī and Dṛshadvatī, (सरस्वती दृषद्वत्योर्देवनद्योर्यदंतराम् । तं देवनिर्मितं देशं ब्रह्मावर्तं प्रचक्षते M.ii.17), Megh.i.48.
ब्रह्मन्-वर्त m. the same as ब्रह्मावर्त q.v.
ब्रह्मन्-आसन n. sitting down for profound meditation.
ब्रह्मन्-आहुति f. the offering of prayers. See ब्रह्मयज्ञ.
ब्रह्मन्-उज्झता f. forgetting or neglecting the Vedas, M.xi.56.
ब्रह्मन्-उद्य n. discussion of theological problems.
ब्रह्मन्-उपदेश m. instruction in the Vedas.
ब्रह्मन्-उपदेश˚नेतृ m. the Palāśa tree.
ब्रह्मऋषि m. a Brāhmaṇīcal sage.
ब्रह्मऋषि m. a Brāhmaṇīcal sage.
ब्रह्मर्षि˚देश m. name of a district, (कुरुक्षेत्रं च मत्स्याश्च पंचालाः शूरसेनकाः । एष ब्रह्मर्षिदेशो वै ब्रह्मावर्तादनंतरः M.ii.19).
ब्रह्मन्-कन्यका f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
ब्रह्मन्-कर m. a tax paid to the Brāhmaṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-कर्मन् n. 1. the religious duties of a Brāhmaṇa; 2. the office of Brahman, one of the four principal priests at a sacrifice.
ब्रह्मन्-कल्प m. an age of Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-काष्ठ m. the mulberry tree.
ब्रह्मन्-कूर्च n. a kind of penance, (अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः । पंचगव्यं पिबेत् प्रातर्ब्र्ह्मकूर्चामिति स्मृताम्).
ब्रह्मन्-कृत् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
ब्रह्मन्-गुप्त m. name of an astronomer who was born in 598 A.D.
ब्रह्मन्-गोल m. the universe.
ब्रह्मन्-गौरव n. regard for the weapon presided over by Brahman (m.), Bt.ix.76.
ब्रह्मन्-ग्रंथि m. a particular joint of the body.

ब्रह्मन्-ग्रह, -पिशाच, -पुरुष म्।, -रक्षस् न्।, -राक्षस म्। m. the ghost of a Brāhmaṇa who, while living, indulges a haughty spirit, (परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च । अरण्ये निर्जल देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः Yaj.iii.212).

ब्रह्मन्-ग्रह, -पिशाच, -पुरुष म्।, -रक्षस् न्।, -राक्षस म्। m. the ghost of a Brāhmaṇa who, while living, indulges a haughty spirit, (परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च । अरण्ये निर्जल देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः Yaj.iii.212).

ब्रह्मन्-ग्रह, -पिशाच, -पुरुष म्।, -रक्षस् न्।, -राक्षस म्। m. the ghost of a Brāhmaṇa who, while living, indulges a haughty spirit, (परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च । अरण्ये निर्जल देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः Yaj.iii.212).
ब्रह्मन्-रक्षस् n. the ghost of a Brāhmaṇa who, while living, indulges a haughty spirit, (परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च । अरण्ये निर्जल देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः Yaj.iii.212).

ब्रह्मन्-ग्रह, -पिशाच, -पुरुष म्।, -रक्षस् न्।, -राक्षस म्। m. the ghost of a Brāhmaṇa who, while living, indulges a haughty spirit, (परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च । अरण्ये निर्जल देशे भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः Yaj.iii.212).
ब्रह्मन्-घातक m. the murderer of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-घातिनी f. woman on the second day of the menses.
ब्रह्मन्-घोष m. the recital of Vedic texts.
ब्रह्मन्-घ्न m. the murderer of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-चर्य (I) n. 1. the condition of a Brāhmaṇa lad in the first period of his life, religious studentship, अविप्लुतब्रह्मचर्यो गृहस्थाश्रममावसेत् M.iii.2; 2. chastity, celibacy, abstinence.
ब्रह्मन्-चर्य (II) m. a religious student.
ब्रह्मन्-चर्या f. chastity.
ब्रह्मन्-चर्य˚व्रत n. a vow of chastity.
ब्रह्मन्-चर्य˚स्खलन n. incontinence.
ब्रह्मन्-चारिक n. religious studentship.

ब्रह्मन्-चारिन् m. 1. a Brāhmaṇa in the first period of his life, which commences from the time of his investiture with the sacred thread, he remains at the house of his spiritual teacher studying the Veda and observing the duties of his Āśrama; he is either नैष्ठिक or उपकुर्वाण qq.vv., M.ii.41, iii.50; 2. one who has taken a vow to lead a celibate life.
ब्रह्मन्-चारिणी f. 1. an epithet of Durgā; 2. a woman who observes the vow of chastity.
ब्रह्मन्-ज m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
ब्रह्मन्-जार m. the paramour of a Brāhmaṇa’s wife.
ब्रह्मन्-जीविन् m. a Brāhmaṇa who lives by sacred knowledge.
ब्रह्मन्-ज्ञ (I) a. one who knows Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मन्-ज्ञ (II) m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Viṣṇu.
ब्रह्मन्-ज्ञान n. divine knowledge, knowledge of the unity of the world and Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मन्-ज्येष्ठ m. the elder brother of Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-ज्योतिस् n. brightness of the deity.
ब्रह्मण्वत् m. an epithet of Agni.
ब्रह्मन्-तत्व n. real knowledge of the supreme spirit.
ब्रह्मन्-तेजस् n. the glory which surrounds a Brāhmaṇa, the potency of Brāhmaṇīsm.
ब्रह्मन्-त्व n. absorption into Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-द m. a spiritual teacher.
ब्रह्मन्-दंड m. 1. a tribute paid to a Brāhmaṇa in the shape of a fine; 2. the curse of a Brāhmaṇa; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
ब्रह्मन्-दान n. the gift of sacred knowledge.
ब्रह्मन्-दाय m. 1. instruction in the Vedas; 2. the Vedas as a hereditary gift.
ब्रह्मन्-दायाद m. a Brāhmaṇa (who receives the Vedas as his inheritance).
ब्रह्मन्-दारु m.n. the mulberry tree.
ब्रह्मन्-दिन n. a day of Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-दैत्य m. a Brāhmaṇa changed into a demon.
ब्रह्मन्-द्विष्, -द्वेषिन् a. 1. hostile to religion and piety; 2. hating Brāhmaṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-द्विष्, -द्वेषिन् a. 1. hostile to religion and piety; 2. hating Brāhmaṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-द्वेष m. hatred of the Brāhmaṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-नदी f. an epithet of the Sarasvatī.
ब्रह्मन्-नाभ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
ब्रह्मन्-निर्वाण n. absorption into the supreme spirit.
ब्रह्मन्-निष्ठ (I) a. engaged in the contemplation of the supreme spirit.
ब्रह्मन्-निष्ठ (II) m. the mulberry tree.
ब्रह्मन्-पद n. 1. the position of a Brāhmaṇa; 2. the place of Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-पवित्र m. the Kuśa grass.
ब्रह्मन्-परिषद् f. an assembly of Brāhmaṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-पादप m. the Palāśa tree.
ब्रह्मन्-पाश m. name of a weapon presided over by Brahman (m.), Bt.ix.75.
ब्रह्मन्-पितृ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
ब्रह्मन्-पुत्र m. 1. a son of Brahman (m.); 2. name of a male river which rises in the Himālaya and with the Ganges falls into the Bay of Bengal; 3. a poison.
ब्रह्मन्-पुत्री f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
ब्रह्मन्-पुर n. the city of Brahman (m.) in heaven.
ब्रह्मन्-पुरी f. the city of Brahman (m.) in heaven.
ब्रह्मन्-पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
ब्रह्मन्-प्रलय m. the universal destruction in which even Brahman (m.) is involved.
ब्रह्मन्-प्राप्ति f. absorption into the divine spirit.
ब्रह्मन्-बध, -वध, -बध्या, -वध्या, -हत्या f. Brāhmaṇīcide, the murder of a Brāhmaṇa.

ब्रह्मन्-बंधु m. 1. a contemptuous Brāhmaṇa; 2. a Brāhmaṇa who is so only by caste; 3. command or instruction given by a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-बीज n. the mystic syllable Om.
ब्रह्मन्-ब्रुवाण m. one who professes to be a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-भवन n. the abode of Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-भाग m. the mulberry tree.
ब्रह्मन्-भाव m. absorption into the supreme spirit.
ब्रह्मन्-भुवन n. the world of Brahman (m.), Bg.viii.16.
ब्रह्मन्-भूत a. become one with the supreme spirit.

ब्रह्मन्-योग m. cultivation of spiritual knowledge.
ब्रह्मन्-योनि a. sprung from Brahman (m.).
ब्रह्मन्-रत्न n. a valuable present made to a Brāhmaṇa.

ब्रह्मन्-रात m. an epithet of Suka.
ब्रह्मन्-राशि m. 1. the whole mass of sacred knowledge; 2. an epithet of Paraśurāma.
ब्रह्मन्-रीति f. a kind of grass.
ब्रह्मन्-रेखा f. the lines written by Brahman (m.) on the forehead of a man indicative of his lot in this world.

ब्रह्मन्-वक्तृ m. a teacher of the Vedas.
ब्रह्मन्-वत् a. possessing religious learning.
ब्रह्मन्-वद्य n. knowledge of Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मन्-वर्चस्, -वर्चस n. 1. eminence in sacred knowledge, holiness resulting from the study of the Vedas, तस्य हेतुस्त्वद्ब्रह्मवर्चसम् R.i.63, M.iv.94; 2. the natural sanctity of a Brāhmaṇa.

ब्रह्मन्-वृंद n. an assemblage of Brāhmaṇas.

ब्रह्मेशय m. 1. an epithet of Kārtikeya; 2. of Viṣṇu.

ब्रह्मन्-सार्ष्टिका f. identification with Brahman (n.), M.iv.232.
ब्रह्मन्-सावर्णि m. name of the tenth Manu.
ब्रह्मन्-सुत m. an epithet of Nārada.
ब्रह्मन्-सू m. 1. an epithet of Aniruddha; 2. an epithet of the god of love.
ब्रह्मन्-सूत्र n. 1. the sacred thread worn over the shoulder; 2. the Vedānta sūtra of Bādarāyaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-सूत्रिन् a. invested with the sacred thread.
ब्रह्मन्-सृज् m. an epithet of Śiva.
ब्रह्मन्-स्तेय n. obtaining a knowledge of the Vedas by illicit means.
ब्रह्मन्-स्व n. the property of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-स्व˚हारिन् a. stealing the property of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्रह्मन्-हन् a. murdering Brāhmaṇa, M.xi.101.
ब्रह्मन्-हुत n. one of the five daily yajnyas consisting in the performance of the rights of hospitality. See M.iii.74.
ब्रह्मन्-हृदय m.n. name of a star.
ब्रह्माणी f. 1. The wife of Brahman (m.); 2. an epithet of Durgā; 3. a kind of brass; 4. a kind of perfume, (रेणुका).
ब्राह्मण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to or becoming a Brāhmaṇa; 2. given by a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मणी f. 1. A woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste; 2. the wife of a Brāhmaṇa; 3. intellect; 4. a kind of wasp; 5. a kind of lizard.
ब्रह्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Relating to Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मिन् (II) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
ब्रह्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Relating to Brahman (n.).
ब्रह्मिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Thoroughly conversant with the Vedas, ब्रह्मिष्ठमाधाय निजेऽधिकारे ब्रह्मिष्ठमेव स्वतनुप्रसूतम् R.xviii.28.
ब्रह्मिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Thoroughly conversant with the Vedas, ब्रह्मिष्ठमाधाय निजेऽधिकारे ब्रह्मिष्ठमेव स्वतनुप्रसूतम् R.xviii.28.
ब्रह्मिष्ठा f. An epithet of Durgā.
ब्रह्मी f. Name of a medicinal plant.

ब्राह्म (I) a. (f. ह्मी) 1. Relating to Brahman (m.), R.xiii.60; 2. relating to Brahman (n.), Bg.ii.72; 3. relating to the Brāhmaṇas; 4. holy, sacred; 5. relating to sacred knowledge; 6. relating to or prescribed by the Vedas.

ब्राह्मी f. 1. The personified energy of Brahman (m.); 2. the goddess of speech; 3. an epithet of Durgā; 4. a woman married according to the Brahma form; 5. the wife of a Brāhmaṇa; 6. the constellation Rohiṇī; 7. name of a medicinal plant; 8. speech; 9. a tale, a narrative; 10. a religious usage; 11. a kind of brass.
ब्राह्म-अहोरात्र m. a day and night of Brahman (m.).
ब्राह्म-देया f. a girl to be given in accordance with the Brahma form.
ब्राह्म-मुहूर्त m.n. a particular period of the early part of the day, ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते किल तस्य देवी कुमारकल्पं सुषुवे कुमारम् R.v.36.
ब्राह्मण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to or becoming a Brāhmaṇa; 2. given by a Brāhmaṇa.

ब्राह्मण (II) m. 1. A member of the first of the four primary castes of the Hindus, a Brāhmaṇa (जन्मना जायते शूद्रः सम्स्कारैर्द्विज उच्यते । कर्मणा याति विप्रत्वं ब्रह्म जानाति ब्राह्मणः) M.i.31, v.95; 2. an epithet of Agni.

ब्राह्मण (III) n. 1. A society of Brāhmaṇas; 2. that portion of the Veda which contains rules for the employment of the Mantras, explanations of sacrifices and illustrations in the way of old stories; (the Veda consists of Mantra and Brāhmaṇa); 3. name of that class of Vedic works which contain the Brāhmaṇa portion of the Veda; (there are extant several Brāhmaṇas: to the Ṛgveda are attached the ऐतरेय and कौशीतकि; to the Yajurveda belongs the शतपथ; पंचविंश and षड्विंश Brāhmaṇas belong to the Sāmaveda and the गोपथ to the Atharvaveda).
ब्राह्मण-अतिक्रम m. insulting behaviour towards a Brāhmaṇa, ब्राह्मणातिक्रमत्यागो भवतामेव भुतये Mv.ii.
ब्राह्मण-अभ्युपपत्ति f. preservation of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण-घ्न m. the killer of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण-चांडाल m. 1. the son of a Śūdra father by a Brāhmaṇa mother; 2. a degraded Brāhmaṇa, M.ix.87.
ब्राह्मण-जात n. the Brāhmaṇa caste.
ब्राह्मण-जाति f. the Brāhmaṇa caste.
ब्राह्मण-जीविका, -वृत्ति f. the means of subsistence allowed to a man of the Brāhmaṇa caste.
ब्राह्मण-जीविका, -वृत्ति f. the means of subsistence allowed to a man of the Brāhmaṇa caste.
ब्राह्मण-त्रा ind. to or to the disposition of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण-द्रव्य, -स्व n. the property of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण-द्रव्य, -स्व n. the property of a Brāhmaṇa.
ब्राह्मण-निंदक m. a reviler of Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्मण-बध, -वध m. the murder of a Brāhmaṇa, Brāhmaṇīcide.
ब्राह्मण-बध, -वध m. the murder of a Brāhmaṇa, Brāhmaṇīcide.
ब्राह्मण-ब्रुव m. one who is a Brāhmaṇa only in name and does not attend to the duties of his caste, सममब्राह्मणे दानं द्विगुणं ब्राह्मणब्रुवे M.vii.85.
ब्राह्मण-भूयिष्ठ a. chiefly consisting of Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन् m. a particular priest at a Soma sacrifice.
ब्राह्मण-संतर्पण n. feeding Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्मण-सात् ind. to the disposition of the Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्मणक m. 1. A vile Brāhmaṇa; 2. name of a country inhabited by warlike Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्मणी-गामिन् m. the paramour of a woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste.
ब्राह्म्य (I) a. (f. ह्म्यी) 1. Relating to Brahman (m.); 2. relating to Brahman (n.); 3. relating to the Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्म्य (II) n. Wonder, astonishment.
ब्राह्म्य (I) a. (f. ह्म्यी) 1. Relating to Brahman (m.); 2. relating to Brahman (n.); 3. relating to the Brāhmaṇas.
ब्राह्म्य-मुहूर्त n. the same as ब्राह्ममुहूर्त q.v.
ब्राह्म्य-हुत n. hospitality.
